Output: (1) walk out of the bedroom and turn left. walk into the kitchen and stop by the counter. walk out of the bedroom and turn right. walk into the kitchen and stop by the counter. (2) walk out of the bedroom and turn left . walk into the kitchen and stop by the counter . walk around the bedroom and turn left . walk into the kitchen and stop by the counter . (3) walk out of the bedroom and turn left. walk into the kitchen and stop by the counter. walk out of the bedroom and turn left. walk out of the kitchen and stop by the counter. Input: Walk straight and turn left. Walk down the hallway and stop in the first doorway on your left. Output: (1) walk straight and turn left. walk down the hallway and stop in the first doorway on your left. walk straight and turn left. walk up the hallway and stop in the first doorway on your left. (2) walk straight and turn left. walk down the hallway and stop in the first doorway on your left. walk straight and turn left. walk down the hallway and stop in the first doorway to your right. (3) walk straight and turn right. walk down the hallway and stop in the first doorway on your left. walk straight and turn right. walk down the hallway and stop in the second doorway on your left. Input: Exit the bathroom. Walk forward and go down the stairs. Stop four steps from the bottom. Output: (1) exit the bathroom. walk forward and go down the stairs. stop four steps from the bottom. exit the bathroom. walk backward and go down the stairs. stop four steps from the bottom. (2) exit the bathroom. walk forward and go down the stairs. stop four steps from the bottom. enter the bathroom. walk forward and go down the stairs. stop four steps from the bottom. (3) exit the bathroom. walk forward and go down the stairs. stop four steps from the bottom. exit the bathroom. walk forward and go down the stairs. stop four steps from the top. Input: walk through open door, turn left, walk toward fireplace turn right, stop outside doorway. Output: (1) walk through open door, turn left, walk toward fireplace turn right, stop outside doorway. walk through open door, turn left, walk toward fireplace turn right, stop inside doorway. (2) walk through open door, turn left, walk toward fireplace turn right, stop outside doorway. walk through open door, go straight, walk toward fireplace turn right, stop outside doorway. (3) walk through open door, turn left, walk toward fireplace turn right, stop outside doorway. walk through open door, turn left, walk away from fireplace turn right, stop outside doorway. The hyperparameters and computation cost of the HEAR's two models are listed in Table 3 (they have the same architecture and are trained in the same way). Other baseline models (§A.2) also have the same hyperparameters.
